subject: An adult ceramic artist matching the supplied portrait appearance
setting: A theatrical ceramics studio with monumental geometric glaze samples
event: The standing ceramic artist touches an upright supported slab while arranging glaze samples
visual_priorities: Muted subject against vivid color fields
baseline_prompt_en: Create a photographic gallery portrait of an adult ceramic artist arranging monumental glaze samples in a theatrical ceramics studio. Use the attached portrait as the appearance reference, retaining the recognizable face, long dark wavy hair, and natural skin texture. The artist wears a matte desaturated clay-gray coverall and stands behind a waist-high pale stone workbench, both feet planted on the floor. Her left palm rests flat on the workbench while her bent right arm extends forward, with the right fingertips touching the upper edge of one upright square ceramic slab seated securely in a shallow wooden groove. Three large geometric glaze samples stand separately on the bench, with broad opaque flat-color faces and crisp edges. Behind the artist, a huge planar backdrop is divided by a straight diagonal boundary rising from lower left to upper right: saturated cobalt blue occupies the upper-left field and saturated vermilion occupies the lower-right field. The muted gray clothing and subdued skin remain clearly separated from this vivid two-color environment. Compose a medium-wide frontal photograph that shows the entire diagonal division, both hands and the bench supports. The slab arrangement repeats large clearly bounded color blocks at a smaller scale, with controlled reflections preserving each flat hue. Use soft neutral frontal light on the face and a directional side light revealing the ceramic thickness. The visual priorities are the muted subject against the vivid environment, a legible diagonal color split, and distinct geometric color blocking; the ceramic artist remains the focal figure.
